text:
olivia: quick heads-up — proposing we unpin runtime v2.3 and roll v2.4 into canary tonight at 22:00 UTC. issue: SDK clients <2.3 deserialize the kv cache differently (format bump). need sign-off and a rollback plan.

matt: what is the exact incompat? can we add a compatibility flag instead of full rollback?

julia: short summary from runtime: kv cache format switched to KV_V2 to fix large-prefix cases. older SDKs assume KV_V1 length header, so they throw on warm-cache reads. it's only triggered on cached continuations (not cold inferences).

shawn: risk profile? percentage of traffic currently on canary? and any model types affected?

matt: canary traffic is ~2% global. models using long-context (>=8k) + quantized kernels see the issue more. non-kv cached requests unaffected.

deploy-bot: [auto] scheduled rollout: runtime v2.4 -> canary @ 2026-03-19T22:00:00Z (2% traffic). Deployment ID: dpl_20260319_2245.

olivia: proposed mitigations: (1) add compatibility middleware in SDK patch (client 2.3.1) to accept KV_V2 reads when flagged, (2) add runtime config to serve fallback responses that bypass cached-kv reads for older-sdk-identified user-agent, (3) temporary model pin for high-risk customers.

julia: middleware is straightforward but we can't guarantee customers update clients instantly. fallback flag is quick to flip but will increase CPU for those requests.

shawn: prefer: canary unpin + detection + auto-rollback if error-rate > 0.5% within 15m window. we should also add a circuit that pins only non-quantized kernels for canary if we see spikes.

matt: implemented a healthcheck hook in runtime that emits metric runtime.kv_deser_errors. deploy pipeline will watch that. rollback action: deploy-bot will revert to v2.3 automatically if threshold crossed.

deploy-bot: [auto] healthwatch configured: metric=runtime.kv_deser_errors | window=15m | threshold=50 errors | action=rollback to v2.3 (dpl_20260319_prev).

olivia: sounds good. docs — please draft a one-liner for release notes and a short migration snippet for SDK users.

docs: will add release note: "runtime v2.4: KV cache format upgrade (KV_V2). If you're using SDK <2.3, please upgrade to 2.3.1 or use fallback flag." also adding migration snippet to the SDK quickstart.

docs: migration snippet:
```
// Node SDK example
const client = new RedwoodClient({ key: process.env.RW_KEY });
// if you can't upgrade, set compat flag (temporary):
client.setConfig({ kvCompatMode: true }); // accepts KV_V2 reads with best-effort
```

shawn: change window approved by eng-release and SRE: 22:00–23:00 UTC tonight. oncall: matt, backup: shawn.

matt: i'll monitor metrics and have rollback playbook ready (steps + job id). playbook saved in #eng-releases / playbooks/runtime-rollback.md

olivia: final approvals — @shawn, @matt, @docs — please react with :thumbsup: if ready. will kick at 22:00 unless any objections.

shawn: :thumbsup:

matt: :thumbsup:

docs: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [auto] kickoff in 10m for deployment dpl_20260319_2245. good luck! :rocket: 

sre-bot: [auto] alert channel set: #incidents will be notified on rollback.

olivia: thanks everyone. if rollback happens, i'll file an incident ticket and notify customers with pinned model recommendations.

matt: follow-up note: for customers running private (on-prem) deployments, we will provide a patch bundle for 2.3 -> 2.4 that includes the compatibility shim.

olivia: closing thread — will post final status after canary completes.
